provider: 豆包云盘 Doubao Drive (ByteDance; storage provided by 北京飞书科技)

free_tier.stated: The first-party terms state an unquantified free allowance for ordinary accounts (一定额度的免费云存储空间) and sell paid expansion plans; the exact quota is unverified on the first-party page.

egress.terms: Not applicable at these sizes; downloads are CDN-served with no published meter.

tooling: OpenList driver `doubao` (cookie auth, download_api select get_file_url/get_download_info, 2 r/s client-side rate limit). Reverse-engineered and explicitly unmaintained ('本接口是基于历史产物的逆向接口').
chaining: ByteDance account per phone number, 10–100 GB each. The 5 TB figure in the API is exactly the 'unlimited that isn't' trap from §3.
limits_note: quota: 100 GB for legacy accounts, 10 GB new. per-object-cap: '上传限制300MB，但是去除一个get参数' can be raised. The 5 TB API value does not correspond to usable capacity.
reliability_note: Quota direction is downward (AI-space free tier was cut to 5 TB then to 100 GB); the interface is unofficial and the 'unlimited' banner has already been retired.

evidence.proved: '豆包通过云盘功能向普通账号提供一定额度的免费云存储空间'
'豆包老用户给100g空间...抓包会显示5TB空间，但实测为上限为100G。新用户给10g空间。上传限制300MB'
'云盘容量上限已锁定为5TB' after '近乎无限容量'
the first-party terms give ordinary accounts an unquantified free allowance and sell paid expansion
evidence.quote: 豆包通过云盘功能向普通账号提供一定额度的免费云存储空间，如果你需要更多存储空间，可自行选择付费购买云存储空间扩容服务的不同方案

evidence.proved: the service is restricted to logged-in users
evidence.quote: 1.3 根据网络实名制规定的要求，本服务仅限登录用户使用。

notes: The stated allowance is deliberately unquantified: '豆包通过云盘功能向普通账号提供一定额度的免费云存储空间'. Reported reality: legacy users 100 GB, new users 10 GB, API reports 5 TB but that is decorative. '注：抓包/facade/get_user_storage会显示5TB空间，但实测为上限为100G'. A 2026-06 protocol revision added paid expansion on top of the free allowance.

dead_end.why: The stated allowance is deliberately unquantified: '豆包通过云盘功能向普通账号提供一定额度的免费云存储空间'. Reported reality: legacy users 100 GB, new users 10 GB, API reports 5 TB but that is decorative — '注：抓包/facade/get_user_storage会显示5TB空间，但实测为上限为100G'.
